item.title: What Edu is reading this week (March 16 - 22, 2026)
item.description: A diverse week featuring deep dives into Btrfs scaling, a flurry of new AI agent control planes, and some critical security updates for CI/CD pipelines. Cloud, Kubernetes & Infrastructure FOSDEM 2026 - The Filesystem Diaries: Scaling Btrfs in an Enterprise - A detailed look at the challenges and solutions for employing Btrfs at scale in large organizational environments. Scaling Btrfs to petabytes in production: a 74% cost reduction story - How one team managed to slash infrastructure costs by leveraging Btrfs features for massive data storage.
